summary: ADR-0058 accepted 2026-08-18; acceptance coordinator evidence root: persisted runs/action DAGs/append-only events/bound registries/route projections/receipts; requests identify target plan and prepared input only, never current route or lifecycle truth; action results bind run,event,registry,candidate,contract,Knowledge,Skill-input,validator IDs; v2 request material historical-only and cannot publish completion; coordinator reentrant/replayable from persisted evidence; reject caller-authored complete graphs,mismatched receipts,unregistered actions; Acceptance exclusively owns acceptance-passed; no Bootstrap ownership/auto-start, release, or commit authority
